aliases: March on the Republican Midterm Convention

caveats: Permit was canceled by the city; march proceeded without a permit per organizers' statements reported by Narativ.

data.description: Coalition march gathering at Pike Park, 2807 Harry Hines Blvd, Dallas at 1 p.m. on Sept. 10, 2026 and marching roughly half a mile toward the American Airlines Center (2500 Victory Ave) during the Republican midterm convention. City of Dallas canceled the special event permit days before; organizers marched anyway. March was halted by police lines and fencing hundreds of feet from the arena; two arrests reported.
data.name: Dallas March on the RNC Midterm Convention
data.outcome: March redirected by police; two arrests; no breach of the security perimeter reported in gathered sources.
participants: Dallas Against the Trump Agenda Coalition marchers; crowds reported at over 100 by local media video.
